# SonoPrep

> SonoPrep is an ARDMS SPI exam prep platform for sonography students and working sonographers. It provides a domain-weighted exam simulator, flashcard system, physics study notes, and Physics Pearls — all built around the official ARDMS SPI content outline by an RDMS instructor.

## What SonoPrep Is

SonoPrep helps candidates pass the ARDMS Sonography Principles and Instrumentation (SPI) exam — the mandatory prerequisite for all ARDMS specialty credentials: RDMS, RDCS, RVT, and RMSKS.

The SPI exam covers 6 domains: ultrasound physics, transducer technology, image optimization, Doppler principles, clinical safety, and quality assurance. The exam draws 110 questions from a question bank, weighted to the actual ARDMS domain distribution.

SonoPrep is not a generic test-prep site. Every product — questions, flashcards, Physics Pearls, and study notes — is mapped to the official ARDMS SPI content outline and weighted by how heavily each domain appears on the exam.

## Products

### Physics Pearls ($9)
50 concise summaries of the most commonly tested ultrasound physics concepts. Formulas, definitions, and clinical relationships. 30-day access. Instant digital delivery.

### SPI Flashcards ($24)
200+ digital flashcards organized by SPI domain. SM-2 spaced-repetition algorithm. Per-card tracking. Works on mobile and desktop. 30-day access.

### Study Notes ($34)
159-page study guide covering all 6 SPI domains across 10 chapters. Written to the ARDMS content outline. Printable. 30-day access.

### Exam Simulator ($49.99)
111-question bank — each exam attempt draws 110 questions, domain-weighted, timed to the real 2-hour SPI format. Per-domain analytics show exactly where you're losing points. 3 attempts. 30-day access.

### Premium Bundle ($99)
All four products included. 45-day access. 10-day full refund, no questions asked.

## Target Audience

- Sonography students in ARDMS-accredited programs (RDMS, RDCS, RVT, RMSKS tracks)
- Repeat SPI candidates who failed on a previous attempt
- Working sonographers refreshing physics knowledge
- Candidates with strong clinical skills but weaker physics background
- Students testing in 2–4 weeks who need focused, domain-weighted prep

## Key Facts

- 6 SPI domains covered at published ARDMS weightings
- 200+ flashcards, 111-question exam bank, 50 Physics Pearls, 159-page study notes
- 30-day access on individual products, 45-day on Premium Bundle
- 10-day full refund policy — no hoops, no questions
- Built by an RDMS instructor at Houston International Cardiotech Ultrasound School (HICUS)
- No subscription — one-time purchase per product
- Free demo: 5 exam questions + 20 flashcards, no account required

## About the SPI Exam

- 110 multiple-choice questions, approximately 90 scored
- 2-hour time limit
- Passing score: approximately 555/700 (scaled)
- Administered at Pearson VUE testing centers and via online proctoring
- Required before sitting for: RDMS, RDCS, RVT, RMSKS, and all other ARDMS specialty credentials
- Retake fee applies on failure — most students pay $250+ per attempt
